subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers require a live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection smoke before merging this narrow header fix, or explicitly accept the credential gap?
rationale: The contributor cannot supply a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate cannot be satisfied by mocked tests alone without maintainer-supplied proof or a maintainer override.

options.title: Require proof or override before merge
options.body: Keep merge blocked until a maintainer with a redacted key posts live endpoint-detection proof, or explicitly records a proof override for this narrow source-level fix.

options.title: Accept source and mocked proof only
options.body: Merge based on the linked issue's live pre-fix evidence plus the PR's focused source and test coverage, accepting the external-service proof gap.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate instead
options.body: Make another open candidate PR the canonical landing path only if it has better proof or a cleaner final patch, then close the rest after merge.

recommendation.title: Require proof or override before merge
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until a maintainer with a redacted key posts live endpoint-detection proof, or explicitly records a proof override for this narrow source-level fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the Z.AI endpoint detection feature and are the strongest history-backed owner for accepting or requiring the live-proof boundary.
